payload.text: ISSUE:0690 (ic filed it at c4eee9b8f), after 0689 on vc's word: the remedy of intent daemon start's 'started and is not answering' says that a piped stdin at EOF becomes intentd's lifeline (ST0073), as its own bank, proved once; if it moves ALL_VARIANTS, cut-surface.md is regenerated in the same bank (releasing.md:95). The trigger is not fully pinned: one unpiped probe over the same ssh kept its daemon. ic's repro probe is at refs/bank/ic/kd331/, and ic's known-defects drive waits for both landings.
